name: Urban legend of skewer
description: There was an urban myth that cheap lamb skewers were made of marinated cat meat.

name: Kaeru
description: The frog girl. At one point she was working at a snack bar - not in a traditional sense but a collectively owned space and she had a shift once a week. I visited her once but I already quit drinking, so I ordered food. Like omelet and beef stew.

name: Fruit and tea
description: The grandparents always treated him with fruit and tea. Conversations were brief, and he was often bored to be there.

name: Kneipe
description: When you walk into a snack bar or kneipe, you need to get attention from the mama. you need to find your role in the space as there are other customers and there is a unique atmosphere.
